name: Critter Kitchen

categories.label: Final meal inputs
categories.hint: Enter the final critic meal, previously earned stars, soup/bisque, and priority position. The Critter Kitchen scorer calculates awards, rumors, course quality, score track, totals, and winner.

tiebreakers.description: Highest total stars after final meal scoring
If tied, furthest score track position; if still tied, player furthest ahead on the priority track

notes: This version stores final meal inputs in the numeric meal record. The authoritative scoring rules are implemented by computeCritterKitchen in @onboard/shared; the generic template formula does not calculate a Critter Kitchen score.
